data.explanation: This is a conditional admission offer: it only becomes a real place once the university checks your previous degree. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by 14 December 2026. If you miss this date, the offer lapses and you would need to reapply. There is no fee or payment involved here, just the document upload. Make sure the certificate copy is properly certified (beglaubigte Kopie), as many German institutions require an official stamp or notarised copy rather than a plain photocopy.
